defects.description: The StatefulSet's serviceName is `web-svc`, but the headless Service that governs it is named `nginx`; there is no Service `web-svc`.
paraphrases: serviceName points at `web-svc`, but the Service is named `nginx`.
The governing Service name should be `nginx`, not `web-svc`.
Dangling reference: no Service `web-svc` is defined.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the StatefulSet serviceName (line 20) with the Service metadata.name (line 4); should be nginx.

defects.description: The StatefulSet selector matchLabels is `app: web`, but its pod template labels are `app: nginx`; a StatefulSet's selector must match its template labels.
paraphrases: matchLabels (app: web) does not match the template labels (app: nginx).
The StatefulSet selects `app: web` but labels its pods `app: nginx`.
Selector/template label mismatch inside the StatefulSet.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the StatefulSet selector (line 24) with the pod template labels (line 28); should be app: nginx.

defects.description: The container's volumeMount references volume `data`, but the StatefulSet's volumeClaimTemplate is named `www`; there is no volume `data`.
paraphrases: The volumeMount name `data` does not match the volumeClaimTemplate `www`.
Dangling volume reference: the mount names a volume the StatefulSet does not provide.
defects.rationale: Findable by comparing the volumeMount name (line 37) with the volumeClaimTemplate name (line 41); should be www.
